reading: No GCR address touches the target, Hyperliquid, or the bridge. Expected, and not evidence against the hypothesis. The cluster's money moved in a two-week window in 2021 and its last real movement was 2025-01-19, when 363.2 ETH from two wallets went into one exchange deposit address. Money entering an exchange cannot be followed, and the target's history only starts 2026-02-05 — so there is nothing to connect yet.
